Description: Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. The Data Scientist will contribute to the development of solutions for digital marketing use cases through statistical methods, data mining and data engineering, working closely with the Analytics, Media Account Management, and Technical Solutions Engineering teams. They will be a data specialist with solid experience in the implementation of propensity models, segmentation analysis, churn modeling, recommendation systems, and descriptive analytics. They will participate in all stages of research, development, and execution of projects for the assigned client, including project definition, data discovery, data engineering, model development and/or data mining, evaluating options, and making recommendations. Responsibilities Nurture client understanding of the importance of building & testing data-driven strategies. Use predictive modeling to increase and optimize customer experiences, revenue generation, ad targeting and other business outcomes. Design and manage experiments to ensure proper execution, data cleanliness, and statistical significance of results. Act as a consultative resource to help clients understand the quality of their internal testing processes. Participate in discovery workshops, feasibility analyses, project planning, estimations, and related activities. Manage projects, including defining and overseeing deadlines, maintaining roadmaps, setting priorities, and ensuring the timely delivery of project milestones. Qualifications MSc or higher in a quantitative STEM subject such as Computer Science, Mathematics and Physics. Proven experience articulating, translating, and solving business problems through data. Hands-on experience in model deployment, governance, and workflow optimization (MLOps). 3+ years of experience in data science (statistical modeling, machine learning for forecasting, classification and optimization) Predictive modeling Experience analyzing large data sets with the Python or R data ecosystem. Experience using large databases (SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery or similar). Ability to explain the analytical methods and results to non-technical stakeholders to drive data-driven decision making. Willingness to both teach others and learn new techniques. Desirable Qualifications Experience with digital analytics platforms (Google/Adobe Analytics) and measurement solutions in the digital advertising industry, preferably with exposure to sectors such as retail, financial services/retail banking, insurance, telecommunications, automotive, or consumer packaged goods (CPG). A set of certifications or work experience in cloud vendors (GCP, AWS, Azure). Experience using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar. Title: Data Scientist IT Security Analytics & Reporting
Description: At Sony, we are looking for a Data Scientist – IT Security Analytics & Reporting who will help us transform large volumes of information into strategic insights to support decision-making within a global organization. This position will be responsible for designing analytics solutions, integrating multiple data sources, including CMDB, endpoint security data, identity management, SCCM/Microsoft Configuration Manager, and cloud environment inventories , developing executive dashboards, and generating security metrics that provide visibility into trends, improvement opportunities, and the organization’s overall security posture. You will work with international technology, infrastructure, and security teams, collaborating across regions and operating companies to build a comprehensive, data-driven view of IT security. Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end data lifecycle, including data extraction, transformation, cleansing, analysis, correlation, and visualization. Build and maintain executive dashboards and security KPIs for CISO-level reporting , providing clear visibility into security posture, trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Design and maintain dashboards using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric or other modern data platforms. Create scalable data models and reporting structures to support global security metrics. Integrate and analyze information from multiple platforms, including CMDB/Asset Management, endpoint security solutions, SCCM/Microsoft Configuration Manager, identity systems, and cloud environments . Integrate cloud inventory and security data from AWS, GCP, and Azure . Reconcile and correlate asset information from different sources to establish a reliable and consistent view of technology assets across regions. Analyze large volumes of data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, data quality issues, and opportunities for improvement. Develop security KPIs and executive reports for global leadership and CISO-level stakeholders. Automate analytics processes and recurring reporting activities to improve efficiency and data reliability. Document data models, pipelines, refresh processes, KPI definitions, and reporting logic. Collaborate with global teams and stakeholders across different regions and time zones to understand information needs and translate them into effective analytics solutions. Support data-driven discussions around security posture, remediation priorities, and operational performance. Requirements Experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Analytics Engineer, Data Scientist, or Data Engineer . Strong experience with Power BI , including data modeling, DAX, and visualization. Strong SQL skills and experience working with large volumes of data. Experience managing databases and integrating multiple data sources. Experience creating dashboards and reports for different levels of an organization, including executive audiences. Experience with CMDB / Asset Management data and reconciling information across multiple sources. Hands-on experience with SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager or other endpoint management/security platforms. Experience working with Microsoft Fabric, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse , or similar modern data platforms. Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, and/or Azure . Ability to analyze complex information and translate it into clear insights and recommendations. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate across regions, teams, and time zones. Advanced English skills for collaboration with international teams.

Title: Senior Research Analyst

You will play an active role in all aspects of client engagement: helping identify issues, forming hypotheses, conducting analysis, and synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Successful candidates will work in a dynamic, and intellectually stimulating, yet supportive environment. Degree in a quantitative subject (Mathematics, Economics, Physics, Engineering, Finance) with a strong academic record and outstanding Grade Point Average Interest in or knowledge of power markets and associated policy frameworks An ability to collect, analyse and interpret complex quantitative data and information Evidence of strong performance in team-oriented environments An ability to communicate and collaborate with both technical and non-technical parties Proficiency in English (C1 level) Written and spoken fluency in Spanish (C2 level) Desirable attributes: Existing knowledge of the Mexican market and energy markets in general Competence in advanced data analytics (e.g. Python, Advanced Excel) To apply, please submit your CV in English What we offer Some of the benefits we include are: A fun, informal and international work culture A competitive salary package Access to regular coaching and mentoring sessions and the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry At Aurora we will consider all requests for flexible working. Title: Analista de Medición y Data Reporting Senior
Description: Buscamos una persona con perfil analítico y orientación a resultados, que disfrute transformar datos en insights que ayuden a mejorar el desempeño y la toma de decisiones. En esta posición tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar de manera autónoma, desarrollar expertise en Agile Measurement y Data Analysis & Reporting , y colaborar con diferentes equipos para analizar información, identificar causas raíz y detectar oportunidades de mejora. ¿Qué harás? Analizar métricas de desempeño y reportes para asegurar el cumplimiento de los procedimientos y lineamientos establecidos. Participar activamente en discusiones de equipo, aportando análisis y soluciones a desafíos del negocio. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia mínima de 1 año en análisis de datos, reporting, métricas de desempeño o áreas relacionadas. Conocimientos sólidos en Agile Measurement. Conocimientos sólidos en Data Analysis & Reporting. Licenciatura o carrera universitaria en un área relacionada. Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios. Buenas habilidades de análisis, comunicación y resolución de problemas. Será un plus contar con Habilidades avanzadas de resolución de problemas. Pensamiento crítico. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación. Capacidad para trabajar colaborativamente con diferentes equipos y stakeholders. Experiencia o conocimientos básicos en coordinación de proyectos.

Title: AI Engineer

Automatizaciones reales: algo que automatizaste para ti, para una empresa, o que vendiste. Algo que construiste sin que nadie te lo pidiera: un side project, un bot, una herramienta. Prueba de que actúas, no solo reaccionas. Una solución que vendiste o escalaste: si transformaste un problema en un producto, o llevaste una app de 0 a +10,000 usuarios, mejor. Liderazgo de proyectos de punta a punta: llevaste proyectos desde la idea hasta producción, presentaste y defendiste tus ideas, y coordinaste equipos multidisciplinarios de diseño, operaciones, tecnología y producto. Hay un nivel de hambre, curiosidad y ejecución que sí es innegociable. Lo que necesitas dominar No pedimos un stack específico. Sí pedimos que estés al día con lo que se usa hoy para construir agentes y sistemas reales. No parchas casos individuales: diseñas sistemas que funcionan para millones de contactos. Eres tan obsesivo con los detalles que los bugs te molestan personalmente. Ante un "no se puede" buscas el "¿cómo sí?", sin esperar permiso. Tienes extreme ownership: el problema es tuyo hasta que está resuelto. Disfrutas trabajar en equipo sin perder autonomía. No necesitas que alguien te diga qué hacer. Sabes presentar y defender tus ideas ante stakeholders, y coordinar equipos multidisciplinarios de diseño, operaciones, tecnología y producto. Te motiva dejar una huella, no solo hacer tu trabajo. Liderazgo de equipo, orientación a resultados y la capacidad de ejecutar iniciativas estratégicas con excelencia. En Rappi, la diversidad nos hace más fuertes Creemos que los equipos diversos e inclusivos construyen los mejores productos, y buscamos activamente personas de todos los géneros, edades, orígenes, religiones y orientaciones sexuales. Si quieres construir el futuro de Latinoamérica, tu lugar es aquí. ¿Te unes al equipo? En Rappi, el límite lo pones tú. Si te apasiona aprender en movimiento y construir soluciones que escalan a millones, queremos conocerte.

Title: Marketing Assistant - Consumer Insights
Description: About Manukora Manukora® is a global wellness brand, leading the fast-growing US Mānuka honey category. We're on a mission to preserve the power of Mānuka and deliver it to the world in pure, functional formats at uncompromising quality, purity and potency. Born in the wilds of New Zealand, we harvest one of the planet's rarest natural resources: raw Mānuka honey. This creamy caramel super honey contains unique antioxidants, prebiotics, and a special antibacterial compound called "MGO." Established in 2015, we are a founder-led, family-owned business headquartered in New Zealand with operations in the United States and globally. Manukora is a certified B Corporation, working with locally-based master beekeeping partners to produce the highest quality Mānuka, leading through ethical beekeeping practices and investing in our bees, their environment and the communities that surround them. We are a team of beekeepers, herbalists, food scientists, and wellness professionals working to deliver this one-of-a-kind honey and reimagine the immune and digestive wellness categories. The Role We're looking for a Marketing Assistant to help run consumer and product research at Manukora. That means our IHUTs (in-home usage tests), surveys, quant and qual studies, and research into new categories and competitors. Working closely with the marketing team. You’ll be deeply involved in the innovation side of the brand, and it's a really fun space to be in. You see products before anyone else does, hear straight from the people using them, and help decide what they become. No two days look the same. One day you'll be prepping product for a study, the next you'll be emailing participants, and the day after you'll be deep in survey results working out what they mean and what we should do based on data. You'll work closely with our operations, retention/CX, marketing and design teams on many projects. Presenting insights and suggestions is the exciting part, but it only works if the base is solid. A big part of this job is organizing, coordinating and checking details across teams. So two things need to be true of you: You're analytical. You can take messy data (survey results, customer reviews, retail data) and tell us what it means and what we should do about it. You're hands-on. You're happy building product kits, communicating with consumers, and designing marketing studies. What the Job Involves Running the logistics of our research: building product research kits, coordinating samples and shipping with our ops team, sending participant incentives, and checking every detail before anything goes out Designing studies and writing surveys Pulling together survey results, customer reviews, Amazon data, retail data and building dashboards Looking after the research inbox and other consumer-facing platforms Digging into new categories, from competitors' packaging to how consumers think and behave Turning what you find into a clear recommendation: what the data is telling us and what we should do about it Sharing reports with the wider team in a clear and concise format Helping improve our research systems and playbooks as we grow Helping out with a variety of marketing tasks across the marketing team Who You Are You're around 1–3 years into your career and already working in a professional environment. You want to build a career in marketing or consumer and product research You're analytical, you can piece the details together and go beyond the numbers You're proactive and heads on to new challenges You're creative and detail-oriented, you notice the small things and pay attention to what's happening in the market around you You're comfortable with data tools, you've used at least one BI tool (Power BI, Looker or similar), or you're very strong in Excel/Sheets, pivot tables included You use AI in your day-to-day work beyond writing, for example to analyze reviews, organize data or structure your thinking You’re comfortable in a fast-moving team where a lot is being done for the first time. You figure things out and keep things moving without waiting for step-by-step instructions You communicate well across teams You're fluent in English, written and spoken, and comfortable presenting findings to the team You don't need a background in marketing but are interested and looking for the next opportunity to learn and thrive in the space. Nice to have: any exposure to surveys, market research, e-commerce or CPG. Experience with Notion, Figma, Claude, Typeform. Why Join Manukora We're building the world's most loved functional honey brand — grounded in science, rooted in nature, and driven by purpose. Title: Strategic Planner
Description: Job Description Emerson has an excellent opportunity for a Strategic Planner to join the Measurement Solutions organization in Latin America. This hybrid position may be based in Brazil, Mexico, or Costa Rica, depending on business needs and candidate location. The Strategic Planner will serve as an integrated business partner to the Measurement Solutions Latin America senior leadership team. This individual will help shape strategy, improve decision quality, and strengthen the region’s management system by connecting business priorities, market insights, planning processes, and applied artificial intelligence. The role is designed for a high-potential professional who can work alongside senior leaders, synthesize complex information, and translate strategic thinking into practical execution. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Strategic Partnership and Executive Support Serve as a trusted and integrated business partner to the Measurement Solutions Latin America senior leadership team, actively participating in the regional management system. Partner with business leaders to identify strategic risks, growth opportunities, and second- and third-order impacts that may affect business performance. Bring independent perspective and sound judgment to strategic discussions, going beyond data synthesis to provide actionable recommendations. Lead the preparation and facilitation of board meetings, growth conferences, site reviews, leadership events, and other high-visibility strategic forums. Support the development and execution of strategic initiatives from ideation and structuring through execution, tracking, and leadership communication. Act as a key connection point between business units, regions, and the broader Measurement Solutions organization to align priorities and improve strategic execution. Strategy, Planning, and Decision Support Conduct business, market, and scenario analyses to support growth planning and executive decision-making. Translate data, market signals, and leadership input into clear insights, implications, and recommendations for senior leaders. Lead or support market research and deep-dive analyses on growth areas, competitive dynamics, customer needs, and strategic risks. You build credibility with senior leaders by listening carefully, asking insightful questions, and providing clear, practical recommendations. You can synthesize complex information across markets, functions, and business units, and you are confident in turning imperfect information into a path forward. Experience in industrial automation, measurement solutions, process industries, energy, chemicals, life sciences, mining, or related B2B industrial markets. Title: Senior Software Engineer
Description: About EarnIn As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey. POSITION SUMMARY Join our DevelSoper Experience team to design and ship AI-native tooling and agentic workflows that meaningfully accelerate the way EarnIn engineers build, ship, and operate software, and help set a new bar for what engineering productivity looks like. This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. WHAT YOU'LL DO Draw on firsthand experience with the friction, toil, and frustrations that slow engineering teams down and use that empathy to build tools and automation that actually solve the right problems. Drive the design, development, and implementation of tools, systems, and processes that accelerate engineering velocity, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar for software delivery. Use the latest AI capabilities LLM APIs, agentic workflows, MCP patterns, and AI-assisted development environments to fundamentally rethink what a high-productivity engineering team looks like. Architect and operate multi-step agentic systems with well-defined inputs, outputs, validation checkpoints, and human-in-the-loop guardrails that run reliably at scale. Embed AI-assisted capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows to improve build reliability, code quality feedback loops, and developer toil reduction. Guide and advise product engineering teams on best practices for building observable, scalable systems acting as a force multiplier across the org, not just within DevX. Partner directly with engineering teams to identify high-friction workflows, translate them into structured AI-assisted automation, and measure impact against defined success metrics. Instrument AI-powered features with end-to-end logging, monitoring, evaluation, and their lifecycle from pilot through iteration or retirement. Document patterns, usage guidance, and best practices so proven workflows can be consistently adopted and extended across the org. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building infrastructure or internal tooling for developer teams; fluency in Python or Go. Firsthand experience with the tools, workflows, and pain points of software engineering teams; you've felt the friction yourself and know how to fix it. Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic or LLM-powered systems in production, including practical familiarity with MCP patterns, tool-augmented workflows, or multi-step agent architectures. Some experience integrating with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) and an understanding of tradeoffs around context management, latency, cost, and safety. Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms, including building custom workflows, reusable actions, or automation that operates on code or pull requests. Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or equivalent); treat these as core to how you work, not a nice-to-have. Ability to define meaningful metrics for AI-assisted tooling and run time-bound experiments to validate impact. Clear written and verbal communication skills, comfortable advising and influencing partner engineering teams in a distributed environment. Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, LLMs) At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Title: Strategic Risk Services Fraud Analyst
Description: Accertify enables commerce by doing one thing extraordinarily well: pinpointing fraud. The company's Predictive Yes Platform helps businesses say yes to more - more good customers, more revenue, and more growth - without getting burned. It's a precise, confident, data-backed yes, made possible by joining signals across the entire customer lifecycle through unmatched data volume, layered AI-powered models, and a consortium approach that protects clients from bad actors spotted anywhere in the network while unlocking business with good actors verified anywhere in the network. With more than 10 billion transactions and over $1 trillion in commerce processed in 2025 alone, Accertify delivers the intelligence and precision that fraud and payments teams need to say yes confidently and enable growth. That's the More Yes difference. As a Fraud Analyst , you'll be on the front lines of protecting businesses and consumers by investigating and analyzing high-risk e-commerce transactions. Your expertise will be key to delivering exceptional digital experiences across industries, ensuring the security and trust that drive success in today's fast-paced online world. You'll be empowered to make impactful decisions, shape fraud-prevention strategies, and contribute directly to the mission to transform the digital landscape. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Identify and prevent fraudulent transactions, powering exceptional client results Work well with a team of industry experts to monitor real-time fraud decisioning software Independently resolve problems that require in-depth investigation and/or research Constantly communicate fraud trends and share best practices with peers and leaders Thoroughly analyze queued transactions to assess fraud risk and approve or reject them accordingly Maintain professional persistence when reviewing transactions or speaking with customers. Prioritize work to meet and exceed deadlines and performance goals Report platform issues as they arise and proactively identify potential impacts to clients Ensure Accertify's customers succeed by delivering results daily. Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's Degree required Strong desire to build a career in the fraud prevention industry Previous e-commerce fraud prevention, investigation, or similar experience preferred but not required Previous knowledge of the e-commerce industry and Card Not Present (CNP) environment or similar experience is preferred, but not required Prior knowledge of airlines, retail, ticketing, banking experience, or similar experience is preferred but not required Fine-tuned organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills are strongly desired Exceptional problem-solving skills Displays confidence in making decisions quickly and independently Must be able to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment Strong internet research skills with the ability to navigate multiple systems at once Demonstrated experience and/or strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite Must have flexibility to work morning, afternoon, and evening shifts, including non-business hours, weekends, and holidays Bilingual Proficiency in Spanish & English Additional Details Location:  On-site at the Accertify Office in Mexico City Flexibility to work a schedule starting as early as 6 a.m. CST (ending at 2 p.m. CST) or as late as 2 p.m. CST (ending at 10 p.m. CST); this will include one weekend day shift, which could change depending on client needs. Training will run from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. for three months, all onsite in the office. Following this training, schedules will be determined based on client needs. For the first 3 months, each workday will be entirely onsite in the office, and the position will become hybrid (3 days in the office, 2 days work-from-home) after the 3-month point. Accertify reserves the right to convert any positions to fully in-office in the future. Additional work-from-office days may be required throughout the year based on client/department needs. PTO blackout periods are from Holly Week (March-April), Hot Sale Week (May), Summer Break (July-Aug), Buen Fin Week (November), and Winter Break (December) through the end of the calendar year. No time off requests are allowed during these periods. Why Join Accertify? At Accertify, we offer more than just a paycheck—we invest in our people through competitive rewards, meaningful benefits, professional development opportunities, flexible ways of working, and programs that support your overall well-being. Join a team that values growth, collaboration, and innovation while empowering you to make an impact and build a rewarding career.
